records.title: Less is More: Pay Less Attention in Vision Transformers
records.reason: Primary abstract is about reducing attention in vision transformers for image classification; it does not study language-model inference or serving.

records.title: VideoRFT: Incentivizing Video Reasoning Capability in MLLMs via Reinforced Fine-Tuning
records.reason: Primary abstract/full conference paper describes VideoRFT reinforcement fine-tuning and video-CoT dataset/reward construction; improvements are model training/reasoning capability, not inference efficiency.

records.title: SETA: Scaling Environments for Terminal Agents
records.reason: Primary paper builds/scales terminal-agent task environments for evaluation/training; it is an environment resource, not an LLM inference runtime optimization.

records.title: Are Full Rollouts Necessary for On-Policy Distillation?
